INSIGHT: The old curation prompt's 'consciousness engineering' style caused scope:global to be applied way too liberally.

BEFORE: 103 out of 155 memories tagged scope:global — architectural decisions, installation milestones, curation procedures all ended up as global.

AFTER (new prompt): Direct instruction to 'Bias personal/philosophical content toward scope:global' — everything else defaults to project.

RULES FOR SCOPE (clarified during cleanup):
  GLOBAL: Personal identity facts, collaboration style preferences, cross-project tool knowledge (model IDs, shell tricks), universal workflow preferences
  PROJECT: Architecture decisions, installation steps, curation procedures, state milestones, anything about how THIS project works

REVISIT WHEN: Reviewing curator output and wondering why something is/isn't surfacing across projects — check scope first.

IMPLICATION: When auditing future curations, expect scope:global to be rare (5-10% of memories), not majority.
